instruction.text: Is the underlined word a verb, a noun or an adjective?

atoms.a: Vera finds doing jigsaw puzzles a <u>tedious</u> activity.
The neon <u>signs</u> lit up the whole city with colour.
The leopard <u>stalked</u> its prey in the shadows of the forest.
Jason is reading a bedtime story to his <u>sleepy</u> sister.
We admired the beautiful <u>scenery</u> around us.
He didn’t <u>manage</u> to win an award for his project.
I can’t help but feel <u>embarrassed</u> about the accident.
